title: You Are More Than Your Worst Day
main_quotation: “Shame says 'I am bad.' Guilt says 'I did something bad.' Recovery learns the difference. You made choices in pain that you would not make in peace. That does not define you.”

title: Small Roots, Strong Tree
main_quotation: “In Athi River, after long dry season, green comes back slowly. First a shoot, then leaves. Healing is like that. Slow growth is still growth.”
